children: US advanced materials maker's fiscal Q3 revenue rose slightly yr/yr to a company record
Fiscal Q3 adjusted EPS rose to $0.02 from $0.01 a year ago
Company secured new defense and semiconductor orders, signed lease to double production space
Company expects continued growth and higher financial results heading into fiscal 2027
Company expects full buildout of new facility to continue into second half of 2027
Company has secured significant volume orders from major customer for deliveries into fiscal 2027
HIGHER DEMAND - Co attributed record Q3 revenue and improved gross margin to increased demand and production
PRODUCTION EXPANSION - Co signed lease for larger facility to expand production and efficiency
DEFENSE CONTRACT ORDER - Co received first defense contractor order for tungsten alloy components using proprietary process
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the electrical components & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for CPS Technologies Corp is $6.00, about 69.5% above its November 2 closing price of $3.54
The stock recently traded at 69 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 32 three months ago
